data_availability_gate.directive: Execute software ingestion validation using isolated synthetic test fixtures only. Modeling remains strictly halted.

rationale: The external data ingestion pipeline, point-in-time joiner, and 10 quality controls have been rigorously implemented, tested, and certified using synthetic test fixtures. However, physical repository inspection confirms that real authorized commercial data files are not yet present in data/external/raw/. In accordance with model risk governance, synthetic fixtures are strictly segregated and cannot be counted as acquired data. Therefore, the research gate decision remains strictly EXTERNAL_DATA_ACQUISITION_REQUIRED, and model training remains halted until commercial data contracts are executed.
production_impact: Zero impact; Production baseline remains frozen at threshold 0.0800.
